product_metadata.title: Wolf Essentials Soft Memory Foam Travel Neck Pillow, Compact, Perfect for Plane or Car, Black
features: PREMIUM COMFORT - Our luxurious crystal fleece neck pillow cover and super soft memory foam will keep you cozy no matter where your nap happens. Our memory foam neck pillow offers support that will keep your head, neck, and shoulders from feeling fatigued.

VERSATILE – This memory foam travel pillow can provide extra support to protect the neck from pain when you are traveling by airplane, car, train, or bus. It can also be ideal for home when watching Netflix or reading on your favorite comfortable chair.

LIFE PROOF - Life can get messy, no worries here. Our travel pillows are durable and easy to clean! Just toss in the wash with like colors in warm water (Yes, the whole thing, no need to remove the filling.) No bleach. Tumble dry on low heat. Do not iron.

GREEN IS GOOD - We strive to preserve our planet for the next generation. By using recycled fibers for our pillow, filling and minimal packaging that’s made from 100% recycled paper, we can help play our part in protecting the environment.

COMPACT AND ADJUSTABLE– The perfect size for getting cozy at home or on the go. Easy to bring along on any trip without sacrificing all your luggage space. Our premium memory foam conforms to the shape of your neck for extra support and comfort.

TRUSTED BRAND - A Texas-based brand and manufacturer since 1946. We are a manufacturer and importer of fine sewn products ranging from neck pillows, travel pillows, microbead pillows, blankets, and more. Our products are imported and filled & finished locally in our Texas facility.
description: World's Best's Memory Foam Travel Pillow. Cushion-soft memory foam wrapped in a plush cover the ultimate in travel comfort. World's Best Your First-Class Comfort Experience in airplane travel accessories.
